sentences.pinyin: Qīxījié kuài dào le, Lìlì duì Xiǎomíng shuō: “Nǐ zhīdào ma? Qīxījié yǒu yīgè hěn měi de gùshì.”
sentences.english: The Qixi Festival was approaching. Lili said to Xiaoming, “Do you know? There is a very beautiful story about the Qixi Festival.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hàoqí de wèn: “Shénme gùshì? Kuài gàosù wǒ ba!”
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked curiously, “What story? Tell me quickly!”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiàozhe shuō: “Hěnjiǔ yǐqián, tiānshàng yǒu yīgè xiānnǚ jiào Zhīnǚ, tā měitiān zhībù.
sentences.english: Lili smiled and said, “A long time ago, there was a fairy in heaven called Zhinü, the Weaver Girl. She wove cloth every day.

sentences.pinyin: Yǒu yītiān, tā láidào rénjiān, yùdàole yīgè jiào Niúláng de niánqīngrén.
sentences.english: One day, she came down to the human world and met a young man named Niulang, the Cowherd.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen xiāng’ài le, jiéhūn hòu guòzhe xìngfú de shēnghuó, hái yǒu le liǎng gè háizi.”
sentences.english: They fell in love, got married, lived a happy life, and had two children.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wèn: “Nà hòulái ne?”
sentences.english: Xiaoming asked, “What happened next?”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: “Hòulái, tiānshàng de Wángmǔ niángniang zhīdào le, tā hěn shēngqì, jiù bǎ Zhīnǚ dài huí le tiānshàng.
sentences.english: Lili said, “Later, the Queen Mother of Heaven found out. She was very angry and took Zhinü back to heaven.

sentences.pinyin: Niúláng hěn shāngxīn, tā dàizhe háizi qù zhuī Zhīnǚ.
sentences.english: Niulang was heartbroken. He took the children to chase after Zhinü.

sentences.pinyin: Wángmǔ niángniang yòng zānzi huà le yītiáo tiānhé, Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ zhàn zài hé de liǎngbiān, bùnéng jiànmiàn.
sentences.english: The Queen Mother used her hairpin to draw a line across the sky, creating the Heavenly River. Niulang and Zhinü stood on opposite sides of the river and could not meet.

sentences.pinyin: Kěshì, měinián qīyuè chūqī, hǎoxīn de xǐquè huì dā yīzuò qiáo, ràng tāmen jiàn yīcì miàn.”
sentences.english: But on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month every year, kind magpies would build a bridge so they could meet once.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: “Tài gǎnrén le! Nà jīntiān wǎnshàng, wǒmen néng kàndào Niúlángxīng hé Zhīnǚxīng ma?”
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, “That’s so touching! Can we see the Cowherd Star and the Weaver Girl Star tonight?”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì diǎntóu: “Dāngrán kěyǐ, děng tiān hēi le, wǒmen yīqǐ qù yuànzi lǐ kàn xīngxīng.”
sentences.english: Lili nodded, “Of course. When it gets dark, let’s go to the yard together to watch the stars.”

sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng, tiān hēi le, Lìlì hé Xiǎomíng láidào yuànzi lǐ.
sentences.english: In the evening, when it was dark, Lili and Xiaoming went to the yard.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen táitóu kàn tiānkōng, xīngxīng yīshǎn yīshǎn de.
sentences.english: They looked up at the sky, where the stars were twinkling.

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì zhǐzhe tiānkōng shuō: “Nǐ kàn, nàtiáo liàngliàng de dàizi jiùshì tiānhé.
sentences.english: Lili pointed to the sky and said, “Look, that bright band is the Heavenly River.

sentences.pinyin: Zài tiānhé de liǎngbiān, yǒu liǎngkē hěn liàng de xīngxīng, yīkē shì Niúlángxīng, yīkē shì Zhīnǚxīng.”
sentences.english: On both sides of the Heavenly River, there are two very bright stars. One is the Cowherd Star, and the other is the Weaver Girl Star.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng zǐxì de kàn, zhōngyú zhǎodào le: “Wǒ kàndào le! Niúlángxīng pángbiān hái yǒu liǎngkē xiǎo xīngxīng, nà shì tāmen de háizi ma?”
sentences.english: Xiaoming looked carefully and finally found them. “I see them! There are two small stars near the Cowherd Star. Are those their children?”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: “Shì de, nǐ zhēn cōngmíng.”
sentences.english: Lili said, “Yes, you are very clever.”

sentences.pinyin: Zhèshí, māma duānzhe yīpán qiǎoguǒ zǒu guòlái, xiàozhe shuō: “Nǐmen zài kàn xīngxīng ne? Lái, chī qiǎoguǒ ba, zhè shì Qīxījié de chuántǒng diǎnxīn.”
sentences.english: Just then, their mother came over carrying a plate of qiaoguo pastries. She smiled and said, “Are you watching the stars? Come, have some qiaoguo. These are traditional treats for the Qixi Festival.”

sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng ná le yīgè qiǎoguǒ, yǎo le yīkǒu, shuō: “Zhēn hǎochī! Māma, Qīxījié zhēn hǎo.”
sentences.english: Xiaoming took one, took a bite, and said, “So delicious! Mom, the Qixi Festival is really nice.”

sentences.pinyin: Lìlì yě shuō: “Shì a, néng hé jiārén yīqǐ kàn xīngxīng, chī qiǎoguǒ, zhēn xìngfú.”
sentences.english: Lili also said, “Yes, being able to watch the stars and eat qiaoguo with family is truly happy.”

sentences.pinyin: Quánjiā rén zài yuànzi lǐ, yībiān chī qiǎoguǒ yībiān kàn xīngxīng, dùguò le yīgè wēnxīn de yèwǎn.
sentences.english: The whole family spent a warm evening in the yard, eating qiaoguo and watching the stars.
